title: Corneal topography and pachymetry
what: A machine takes pictures of the cornea, the clear front part of the eye. It shows its shape and thickness.
why: Before laser vision correction, when fitting contact lenses, and when keratoconus is suspected or followed.
duration: usually 5 to 15 minutes; results right away
tell_doctor: If you wear contact lenses, and what kind
If you had eye surgery or eye injuries

prepare.title: Contact lenses
prepare.text: Soft lenses are usually stopped a few days before, hard lenses longer. The clinic will tell you exactly.

prepare.title: Makeup
prepare.text: Come without mascara or eye shadow.

steps: You sit at the machine and rest your chin on the stand
The machine takes pictures of each eye
Sometimes thickness is measured with a small probe after eye drops
The doctor looks at the maps and explains the result
feel: The light is bright, and you need to keep from blinking for a few seconds
If a probe is used, numbing drops are put in first
after: You can go back to your normal day right away
If you had drops, do not rub your eyes for 20 to 30 minutes
The doctor will discuss the result right away or at your visit

faq.q: Why stop wearing contact lenses beforehand?
faq.a: Lenses change the shape of the cornea, and the result will not be accurate.
Usually yes. If you had drops, ask the doctor.

reminders.text: Cornea test tomorrow. Check if you need to stop wearing contact lenses first. No eye makeup.
